Detected that jxlinfo (part of the libjxl toolset) is not installed on this system.

In "JPEG output" mode, the program must check each JXL individually to see if it can be bit-rebuilt into the original JPG. With jxlinfo it only parses the file header (milliseconds); without it, it falls back to full djxl decode verification, which is noticeably slower for bulk conversions.

It is recommended to install jxlinfo from the libjxl release page and add it to PATH; this significantly improves verification performance. (Does not affect functionality, only speed.)
